POSL.description: Seismic Load Parameters (POSL). METHOD (RES_DISP vs EQV_STATIC) plus SZ/SC/EPA drive the seismic-coefficient computation, and FA/FV/SDS/SD1/EPGAeff/Kae are derived by the solver rather than supplied by the caller.

CODE.description: Seismic load design code. Case-insensitive; only KDS(41-17-00:2019) is supported in this build.

METHOD.description: Seismic analysis method (case-insensitive). RES_DISP = Response Displacement method (requires SC=S1; FA/FV/SDS/SD1 are computed). EQV_STATIC = Equivalent Static method (EPGAeff/Kae are computed).

EPA.description: Effective Peak Ground Acceleration (S). Used as the zone factor input for both methods.

SC.description: Site class (case-insensitive). [METHOD=RES_DISP] must be S1; any other value is rejected with a wrong-field error.

FA.description: Short-period site coefficient Fa. Computed by the solver from EPA and SC; not taken from the request payload.

FV.description: Long-period site coefficient Fv. Computed by the solver; returned on GET (RES_DISP method).

SDS.description: Design spectral response acceleration at short period. Computed by the solver (RES_DISP); returned on GET.

SD1.description: Design spectral response acceleration at 1-second period. Computed by the solver (RES_DISP); returned on GET.

EPGAeff.description: [METHOD=EQV_STATIC] Effective EPGA, = (2/3)*EPA*Fa. Computed by the solver; returned on GET only for the Equivalent Static method.

Kae.description: [METHOD=EQV_STATIC] Seismic coefficient Kae, = 0.75*EPGAeff. Computed by the solver; returned on GET only for the Equivalent Static method.
